Sam (AE): Prospect POC hitting 413 when sending system prompt + full history (they embed policy + examples). Body ~118KB. Endpoint: POST /v1/generate model=rw-chat-8k. Anyone seen this lately?
Rae (SE): Gateway log?
Sam (AE): They sent this: 
ingest-bot: gateway: client 10.5.6.7 request rejected: request_entity_too_large, length=121700, client_max_body_size=104857
Anu (SRE): That's our nginx front proxy 100KB cap. It fails before runtime.
Rae (SE): Quick workarounds: 1) gzip body and set Content-Encoding: gzip 2) move long examples to object storage via presigned upload and pass small pointer 3) send trimmed recent turns + short summary of older context.
Sam (AE): Can we make an exception for hosted demo?
Anu (SRE): We can't change per-account proxy limit on hosted without infra change. Ops can spin short-lived Dedicated sandbox if they need single-call.
Rae (SE): Note: switching to a 32k model doesn't avoid the HTTP limit. It only affects token context once the payload is accepted.
Sam (AE): Sample gzip curl I can send:
```
echo -n '{"model":"rw-chat-8k","input":"<LONG_CHAT>"}' | gzip -c | \n  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \n    -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' \n    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n    --data-binary @-
```
Rae (SE): Presigned flow sketch: POST /v1/uploads/initiate -> presigned PUT URL -> client uploads -> POST /v1/generate with context_url -> backend pulls server-side.
Sam (AE): Prospect tried gzip and got 200. They're validating model output now. Thanks all :tada:
